# Daqi

> Daqi (daqi.shop) is a global online store for downloadable digital products: AI prompt packs, collectible card packs, planners, printables, wallpapers, templates, and faith & culture products localised for many countries and languages. All items are digital with instant delivery.

## Key pages
- Store home: https://daqi.shop/
- Sitemap: https://daqi.shop/sitemap_index.xml
- Shop (all products): https://daqi.shop/shop/

## About products
- All products are virtual/digital; most are downloadable files delivered after purchase.
- Prices are in USD.
- Product pages include structured data (schema.org Product with price and ratings).
- Content is provided in many languages/editions for different countries.
